|champion     = Swain
|skill        = W

|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|70/2 to 210/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/2}}% AP)}}}}
|description2 = Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 6 seconds and have a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} collected from them.
|target range = {{ap|5500 to 7500}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 325
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 80}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 18}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.3}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|spellshield  = Special
|parry        = 
|projectile   =

* Enemy {{tip|champions}} protected by a {{tip|spell shield}} do not have a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} collected from them but are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} anyway.
* ''Vision of Empire'' will grant {{as|Soul Fragments|buzzword3}} from hitting {{tip|clone|clones}}.
* '''Swain''' will not receive the {{as|Soul Fragments|buzzword3}} if ''Vision of Empire'' hits enemy champions while he is dead.
* ''Vision of Empire'' is visible and audible to enemies through the [[sight|fog of war]].

|champion     = Swain
|skill        = E
|icon         = Nevermove.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Swain}} launches a demonic wave in the target direction.

|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' launches a demonic wave in the target direction.
|description2 = At maximum range, the wave homes back to '''Swain''' and detonates upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. ''Nevermove'' can be recast while {{tip|champions}} hit are rooted.

* ''Nevermove's'' missiles have their speed update to accelerate at specific times by the server. The client applies these speed increases after additional specified delays, while the hitbox behaviour itself only uses the timings noted above.
* ''Nevermove's'' recast can be used during the cast time of other spells.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block either the detonation on the first cast or the pull from the recast.
** If the recast is blocked, the target will also prevent a {{as|Soul Fragment|buzzword3}} being collected from them.

R.name: Demonic Ascension
R.title: Template:Data Swain/Demonic Ascension
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Demonic Ascension|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Swain
|skill        = R
|icon         = Demonic Ascension.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Swain}} frees the demon within, gaining ''Demonic Ascension'' and generating {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}}. ''Demonic Ascension'' is maintained with {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}} that gradually decays over time.
|blurb2      = '''Swain''' generates {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}} while draining from at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, and fully restores it upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}.
|blurb3      = After a short time, '''Swain''' can cast ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'' and does so automatically when ''Demonic Ascension'' expires.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|Demonic Ascension:}} '''Swain''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and continually drains the lifeforce of nearby enemies, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|healing}} himself.
|post-blurb = Swain/Demonflare
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Swain''' frees the demon within himself, gaining ''Demonic Ascension'' and generating {{as|50 Demonic Energy|azakana}}. ''Demonic Ascension'' is maintained with {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}}, which decays by {{as|5|azakana}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to {{as|{{fd|7.5}}|azakana}} after 5 seconds have elapsed. ''Demonic Ascension'' is lost once all {{as|Demonic Energy|azakana}} is depleted to {{as|0|azakana}}. '''Swain''' generates {{as|10 Demonic Energy|azakana}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds while draining from at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, and fully restores it to the maximum of {{as|50|azakana}} upon scoring a {{tip|champion}} {{tip|takedown}}.
|description2 = {{sbc|Demonic Ascension:}} '''Swain''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and drains the lifeforce of nearby enemies, both dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|healing}} himself every {{fd|0.5}} seconds per target affected. The heal is reduced by 90% against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|15/2 to 35/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4/2}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|15/2 to 45/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5/2}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5/2}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}|Reduced Heal per Tick|{{ap|15*0.5*0.1 to 45*0.5*0.1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5*0.5*0.1}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*0.5*0.1}}% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}
|description3 = After 2 seconds, '''Swain''' gains the ability to cast ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'', up to 100 times, and does so automatically when ''Demonic Ascension'' expires if ''{{ai|Demonflare|Swain}}'' is not on cooldown at the time of expiration.
|description4 = ''The targets do not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''
|description5 = '''''Swain''' can move during Demonic Ascension's cast time.''
